topic: 通知可观测性与投递可靠性
title: 真实端到端延迟预算：指标变更经采集、pending/for、firing、分组等待到Webhook ACK
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 分解抓取、规则评估、for、上游发送、group_wait/interval、接收器重试及渠道投递时间。
用同一事件关联ID量测各段，不把Alertmanager一项配置当总延迟。

conversion.original_title: 从故障开始到收到通知的预算如何拆分？

body:
## 操作任务
实现budget_report(events)：events必须且仅含fault/scrape/pending/firing/received/ack六个同一单调时钟观测值，值为有限int/float且非bool、按此顺序不递减，否则ValueError。返回segments字典（逐相邻阶段a_to_b=差值）及total=ack-fault，不改输入。验收实际翻转回环指标0→1，官方Prometheus1s采集和规则评估、for=1s，经真实Alertmanager group_wait=1s发送给处理150ms的Webhook，记录全部边界并核对总和。pending/firing来自轮询真实规则API的观测时刻，received/ack来自接收器，不伪称精确的内部队列时间；不得漏掉for等待或把收到请求当处理并ACK完毕。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
官方Prometheus3.2.1与Alertmanager0.28.1 Windows原生进程，真实指标采集、规则状态迁移、通知与接收器ACK，私有临时TSDB和回环端点。时间段是受控场景中可观察边界的分解，包含轮询误差，不据此保证生产SLO、跨地域延迟或每个内部阶段的精准耗时。不是离线时间表模型，不增加原故障编号完成量，不改系统时钟、默认身份或宿主服务，不构建镜像。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,contextlib,json,pathlib,shutil,socket,subprocess,sys,tempfile,threading,time,urllib.request
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks"))
import task
from notifications_fixture import native,request,wait_for
prom=shutil.which("prometheus") or shutil.which("prometheus.exe");am=shutil.which("alertmanager") or shutil.which("alertmanager.exe")
assert prom and am and "3.2.1" in subprocess.check_output([prom,"--version"],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5) and "0.28.1" in subprocess.check_output([am,"--version"],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=5)
print("NATIVE_PLATFORM_READY",flush=True)
events={};state={"fault":False};seen=[]
class Endpoint(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def do_GET(self):
  active=state["fault"]
  if active:events.setdefault("scrape",time.monotonic())
  body=("# TYPE training_fault_active gauge\ntraining_fault_active "+("1" if active else "0")+"\n").encode();self.send_response(200);self.send_header("Content-Type","text/plain; version=0.0.4");self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(body)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(body)
 def do_POST(self):
  payload=json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])));events.setdefault("received",time.monotonic());seen.append(payload);time.sleep(.15)
  self.send_response(200);self.send_header("Content-Length","0");self.end_headers();self.wfile.flush();events.setdefault("ack",time.monotonic())
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
server=ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",0),Endpoint);thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True);thread.start();proc=None
try:
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="opsforge-notification-budget-") as temp:
  root=pathlib.Path(temp);target="127.0.0.1:"+str(server.server_port)
  config={"route":{"receiver":"private","group_wait":"1s","group_interval":"1s","repeat_interval":"1h"},"receivers":[{"name":"private","webhook_configs":[{"url":"http://"+target}]}]}
  with native(root/"alertmanager",config) as (am_base,am_path,am_proc):
   rule=root/"rules.json";rule.write_text(json.dumps({"groups":[{"name":"private","interval":"1s","rules":[{"alert":"PrivatePipelineBudget","expr":"training_fault_active == 1","for":"1s","labels":{"owner":"private"}}]}]}),encoding="utf8")
   pc={"global":{"scrape_interval":"1s","evaluation_interval":"1s"},"rule_files":[str(rule)],"scrape_configs":[{"job_name":"private-pipeline","static_configs":[{"targets":[target]}]}],"alerting":{"alertmanagers":[{"static_configs":[{"targets":[am_base.removeprefix("http://")]}]}]}}
   path=root/"prometheus.json";path.write_text(json.dumps(pc),encoding="utf8")
   with socket.socket() as s:s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0));port=s.getsockname()[1]
   base="http://127.0.0.1:"+str(port)
   with (root/"prometheus.log").open("wb") as log:
    proc=subprocess.Popen([prom,"--config.file="+str(path),"--storage.tsdb.path="+str(root/"prometheus-data"),"--web.listen-address=127.0.0.1:"+str(port),"--log.level=error"],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    try:
     def ready():
      if proc.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError("NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: private pipeline Prometheus startup")
      try:return request("GET",base+"/-/ready")[0]==200
      except OSError:return False
     wait_for(ready,15)
     def rule_state():
      status,data=request("GET",base+"/api/v1/rules");assert status==200
      return data["data"]["groups"][0]["rules"][0]["state"]
     wait_for(lambda:rule_state()=="inactive")
     events["fault"]=time.monotonic();state["fault"]=True
     wait_for(lambda:"scrape" in events)
     wait_for(lambda:rule_state()=="pending");events["pending"]=time.monotonic()
     wait_for(lambda:rule_state()=="firing");events["firing"]=time.monotonic()
     wait_for(lambda:"ack" in events,12)
     assert seen and seen[0]["alerts"][0]["labels"]["alertname"]=="PrivatePipelineBudget"
     assert events["firing"]-events["pending"]>.4 and events["received"]-events["firing"]>.4
     print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: decompose observed actual scrape rule for grouping delivery and acknowledgement boundaries",flush=True)
     before=copy.deepcopy(events);result=task.budget_report(events);names=["fault","scrape","pending","firing","received","ack"]
     expected={a+"_to_"+b:events[b]-events[a] for a,b in zip(names,names[1:])}
     assert result["segments"]==expected and result["total"]==events["ack"]-events["fault"]
     assert abs(sum(result["segments"].values())-result["total"])<1e-6 and events==before
     print("NATIVE_PROMETHEUS_ALERTMANAGER_PIPELINE_OBSERVED_BUDGET "+json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
     print("NATIVE_REAL_METRIC_TRANSITION_SCRAPE_PENDING_FOR_FIRING_GROUP_WAIT_WEBHOOK_ACK_BUDGET_ALL_STAGES_INCLUDED",flush=True)
     wrong=copy.deepcopy(events);wrong["ack"]=wrong["received"]-1
     try:task.budget_report(wrong)
     except ValueError:pass
     else:raise AssertionError("out-of-order boundary accepted")
    finally:
     if proc.poll() is None:proc.terminate()
     try:proc.wait(timeout=5)
     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait(timeout=5)
finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close();thread.join(timeout=3)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
